source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 朝阳谷来客，后院暂避
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC14 after EP02 SC13 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the blood-letter warning into the next external-pressure beat: Tuobaye asks the white-clothed woman to accompany him to Mirage City and is refused; Chaoyang Valley Shisilanggongzi arrives across Tianhu to seek Qingdi; the woman decides they should avoid the visitors; she carries Tuobaye by invisible force into the rear courtyard while the white dragon-deer follows; they hide separately among bamboo as Shisilanggongzi, an elder, and attendants wait respectfully outside Qingdi's forbidden courtyard.
title: 朝阳谷来客，后院暂避

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC13 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH04 has production-level identity drift: the white-clothed woman's headpiece is too ornate and Tuobaye is too tribal/refined.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 白衣女子将神帝血书折好隔空递还拓拔野，并说纵使血书交与青帝，青帝恐怕也不会随他去蜃楼城。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 拓拔野追问缘由，白衣女子只说其中复杂，去了蜃楼城自然知道。拓拔野焦急，转而请求她陪自己去蜃楼城，却被她微笑婉拒。正在他失望无计时，天湖对岸传来朝阳谷十四郎拜见青帝的喊声。白衣女子微皱眉，说朝阳谷的人来了，要避上一避。她衣袂飘飞，以无形气流带着拓拔野掠入三进庭院后院，白龙鹿紧随。她让拓拔野藏在西侧竹丛，自己立于东侧竹下；门外十四郎、黑衣老者和两个大汉恭敬走近，反复报见，却不敢踏入青帝禁中之禁。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 二人分藏竹下时，拓拔野沉浸在白衣女子若即若离的情绪里；白衣女子则思索拓拔野与刹那芳华、无锋剑、神农托付之间的因缘。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains adult, elegant, distant, water/rain-associated, fully clothed, emotionally restrained, and should not drift into ornate court jewelry styling.
White dragon-deer may appear as a loyal companion following Tuobaye; keep it graceful and non-threatening.

Chaoyang Valley visitors are external pressure, not the emotional center: black-clothed young noble Shisilanggongzi, black-clothed elder, and two attendants may appear at a distance or outside the courtyard gate.
Qingdi should not appear; show his absence through closed courtyard, empty pavilion, respectful visitors waiting outside, and silent architecture.
The courtyard is Qingdi's forbidden inner residence: three-entry garden, bamboo on east/west sides, wet stone, moonlit pine shadows, distant Tianhu mist.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, speech bubbles, English words, signs, plaques, gate calligraphy, letter contents, UI, or clear inscriptions.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may include intended Chinese dialogue as off-screen planning context, but must request no rendered subtitles or readable text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no lip-sync dialogue, no crowd shouting audio, no music, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, sound design, music, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Use restrained refusal, distant visitor arrival, silent gliding movement, hiding among bamboo, and respectful waiting outside the gate. Avoid lip-sync, readable documents, readable gate signs, and complex crowd action.

suggested_shots.title: 同行之请被婉拒
suggested_shots.visual_focus: After receiving the folded letter, adult Tuobaye urgently asks the white-clothed woman to go with him to Mirage City; she gives a faint distant smile and refuses, leaving him visibly disappointed.

suggested_shots.title: 天湖对岸来客
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Across the moonlit Tianhu, distant black-clothed visitors appear near the courtyard approach as external pressure; Tuobaye and the woman both turn toward the sound, but no one speaks on-screen.

suggested_shots.title: 行云掠入后院
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The white-clothed woman moves like flowing cloud, carrying adult Tuobaye by invisible force into the rear courtyard; the white dragon-deer follows through moonlit mist and bamboo.

suggested_shots.title: 竹影后静候来人
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye hides behind west-side bamboo with the white dragon-deer while the woman stands apart under east-side bamboo; beyond layered doors, Shisilanggongzi and attendants wait respectfully outside Qingdi's silent courtyard.
